svg.text: RDK X5 — 24 MiB test file: tmpfs (/data) vs ext4 (/userdata)
Perfetto linux.sys_stats meminfo @250 ms; x = seconds relative to workload_start; shaded band = tmpfs file alive (dd .. rm)
MemAvailable (MiB): headroom the kernel reports to userspace
Cached (MiB): page cache (also counts tmpfs pages)
Source: run1.pftrace / run2.pftrace (Perfetto v57.1-c59f57dd4), values converted bytes->MiB. Cached and Shmem overlap for tmpfs pages: do not add them.
